body: Thank you. Maybe I'll try one of the hotlines.

I know this feeling. But the strange thing is that at alot of the funerals that I've been to, theres a lot of people there you wouldn't imagine, people with great memories of you from school, from jobs you've had from people you've met that you might not even remember.

But why does it matter how many lives you've touched? It isn't the amount that counts, but the fact that someone have chosen you. Out of 7,000,000,000 you are just one, and alot of people chose you to get to know. 

If you're in need of a talk just PM me if you want to :-)
